utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, the repair drive? I hope it goes well, but I'm not sure I can do much to help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: No worries, Uli! Even just showing up for moral support would be great. It's at 10, right? I think I remembered that part.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, 10 sounds right. I'll try to stop by, but no promises.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I'll check with Quinn and get back to you on the list.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thanks Leo! Don't forget it's now Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it, Sunday at the community center. I'll confirm with Quinn.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Faye, still waiting on Gus's list — should have details tonight.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I'll bring the school calendar to our meeting tomorrow at the community center at 10am — hopefully Gus's list will help us finalize the plan.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, I'll check for Gus's list tonight and see you at 10.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Cleo, I've got my tools ready for the repair drive. Need me to bring anything specific?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Gus, I'm still trying to nail down the exact list. Eli suggested checking the bulletin board at the community center—I'm heading there soon.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can swing by the community center with you if you want; I'm free this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'm always free in the mornings. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We're meeting at Rosa's place at 10 tomorrow to hash out the repair drive details—you should come!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: But I already agreed to meet at the community center at 10 with Faye for the repair drive. Are those the same event?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh hi Pia! Have you heard about the repair drive this weekend? I'm so excited to get everyone together to fix things up.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I heard it's on Sunday at the community center, but are we sure we're all talking about the same repair drive? I don't want to confuse it with the server one or the old laptop job.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh no, it's definitely the neighborhood one! We're fixing things like broken chairs, leaky faucets, and that old fence by the park.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Opal! We're organizing a repair drive this Saturday at 10 AM at the community center. Want to join?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, that sounds great! I've been noticing some things around the neighborhood that need fixing—like the Johnson house shingles and the Miller place spigot.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, Opal! Those are perfect examples of what we'll be tackling. Can we count you in for Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Hana, did I miss something about the repair drive? I think there's a meeting tomorrow at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Noah, before we talk about the meeting, can you clarify which repair drive you mean? The server one or the laptop one?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the laptop one—the one we're organizing with the school calendar. Sorry, I sometimes mix them up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I hope they've got the parking and scheduling sorted out for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I think Vik's got the schedule under control, and I offered to help spread the word on other streets.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That's good to hear. Let's hope the parking works out too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Dane, I'm planning to set up the repair drive schedule this weekend, and Jules is helping spread the word on Maple Street and at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good, Vik. I'll check with Rosa about the list first, then we can sort out a time.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, Dane! Just let me know when you're ready, and I'll have the schedule ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven't seen it personally, but Opal's got a list of specific spots—that's more than we've had before.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That's great to hear! I've been helping Vik organize the schedule, so we're getting more coordinated.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, with you and Vik organizing, it feels like this time it's really going to happen.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard from Eli it's this Saturday at the community center. Maybe we can check the bulletin board together to see if it looks legit.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you know what time the drive starts on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'm not sure about the time yet—let's check the bulletin board, it should have the details.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks Gus, that'd be great! Kira, we're getting a good team together for this.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I still need to see it work before I believe it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Kira, why not come by this weekend and see for yourself? We'll be getting started on the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I hope the organizers have a good plan for parking and scheduling.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Absolutely, I'm really hoping they've got that sorted out—it's been a major worry of mine.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I know, it's hard to relax when you're not sure about the details.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Bo, are we still on for the repair drive? I was talking to Dane earlier about getting started once he checks with Rosa.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, yeah, I think so. Gus is supposed to send a list tonight, so I'm just waiting on that.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Alright, sounds good. Let me know if you need any help once the list comes in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Cleo, did you hear about the repair drive this Saturday? I heard it's at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, I've been meaning to check the bulletin board for the supply list. I'll head over later.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Want to go together? I was planning to check it out too, and we can make sure the info is legit.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Oren! Have you heard about the repair drive? I'm helping organize it—want to join?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, yes! The repair drive! I think I was supposed to be there at 10? I hope I didn't mix it up with my toaster repair again.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No mix-up, Oren! It's definitely this Saturday at 10 AM at the community center. Hope your toaster's not giving you too much trouble!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, just the usual house repairs around the neighborhood—nothing to do with computers.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Got it—just house repairs. We're meeting tomorrow at 10am at the community center to plan it out; want to join?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I'd love to join. I can share my observations about the Johnson and Miller places. See you there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Noah, sorry I'm late to the party. What's the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Dane! We're meeting at the community center tomorrow at 10 to sort out the schedule with the school calendar. Jules and Mara are helping too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good, I'll be there. I also need to check with Rosa for the list before we start.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That's good to hear, Vik. I'll try to stop by if I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great! I'm planning to set up the schedule this weekend, and Jules is helping spread the word on Maple Street and at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds like a solid plan. I'll see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I'm happy to help out with the repair drive, Ira. Just let me know what tools you need and when.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Gus! Vik's putting together a schedule this weekend, and Jules is helping spread the word. I'll let you know as soon as we have the details.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Ira. I'll keep my evenings open for whenever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Morning. What's the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Good morning, Leo! Rosa and I are meeting tomorrow at 10 to plan around the school calendar I'm picking up.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it. I'll be there at 10 tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: You're welcome, Cleo. I'll see you at 10am.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, are we all meeting at 10? I'll be there too!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, Tess! The more the merrier. See you both at 10.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Just wanted to update you, Mina—the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and they've opened the overflow lot for parking.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So it's the neighborhood repair drive, not the server. Sunday at the community center, got it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I'm glad that's clear. See you on Sunday!
